name: Unidentified barbed light blue species
description: This species was a bipedal humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their light blue skin, as well as a fin-like growth on top of their head and four pointed barbs extending from their face. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor.
